title: The hammock
html_source: As you can still see today in the Sandycove Martello tower (now preserved and operated as the James Joyce Tower and Museum), the second floor living space did not have enough room for three beds, and scarcely enough room for two, so Haines (or in real life, Samuel C. Trench) sleeps on a hammock in the corner. The living room also contained their breakfast table, a stove, a fireplace, and a locker box referred to in the previous line.
